slides.texte_overlay:
unwritten psychology codes
that get you ahead in life

the ben franklin effect:
ask someone for a small favor.
they'll like you more after.

the zeigarnik effect:
start the task. your brain
won't let it go unfinished.

the peak-end rule:
people remember how it ended.
end every meeting well.

the curiosity gap:
the more you know,
the more doors open.
